channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Before the Next Victory Lap
item.description: Australia’s smoking statistics are raising new questions about the effectiveness of its tobacco control policies. The 2026 Wesfarmers Health Index estimates daily smoking at 10.1%, considerably higher than the government's reported figure of 5.6%, although differences in survey methods may explain part of the gap. (Published on October 22, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: expert reaction to study of vascular function and cardiorespiratory fitness in young adults who vape
item.description: A new study inJAMA Cardiologyexamining vascular function and cardiovascular fitness among young adults who vape has drawn criticism from leading researchers over significant methodological limitations. (Published on October 22, 2026bysciencemediacentre.org)

item.title: Why Are Nicotine Pouches Sold Through Pharmacies in Canada? | #GFN26ScienceLab
item.description: Canada's pharmacy-only model for nicotine pouches has created an unusual regulatory imbalance. Since 2024, authorised pouches have been restricted to pharmacy sales, while unauthorised products remain widely available through online and retail channels. (Published on October 22, 2026bygfn.tv)

item.title: UKVIA urges MPs to protect responsible vape retailers
item.description: Responsible vape retailers should not face the same treatment as businesses selling illegal products, the UK Vaping Industry Association has told MPs. (Published on October 22, 2026byconveniencestore.co.uk)
